diff --git a/drafts.py b/drafts.py
index 5a74029..b1028c2 100644
--- a/drafts.py
+++ b/drafts.py
@@ -16,6 +16,12 @@ def age_days(draft, today):
     return (today - draft["saved"]).days
 
 
-def to_remove(drafts, today):
-    """Drafts the clean-up should get rid of."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+def to_remove(drafts, today, retention_days=None):
+    """Drafts the clean-up should get rid of.
+
+    A draft is removed when it is older than retention_days (from
+    config.ini unless given). A draft exactly retention_days old is kept.
+    """
+    if retention_days is None:
+        retention_days = load_config().getint("drafts", "retention_days")
+    return [d for d in drafts if age_days(d, today) > retention_days]

+from datetime import date, timedelta
 
 import drafts
 
@@ -11,3 +11,27 @@ def test_age_days():
 def test_config_loads():
     cfg = drafts.load_config()
     assert cfg.getint("editor", "autosave_seconds") == 30
+
+
+def _draft(name, today, days_old):
+    return {"subject": name, "saved": today - timedelta(days=days_old)}
+
+
+def test_to_remove_uses_configured_retention():
+    today = date(2026, 11, 18)
+    keep_recent = _draft("recent", today, 3)
+    keep_edge = _draft("edge", today, 45)
+    drop_old = _draft("old", today, 46)
+    result = drafts.to_remove([keep_recent, keep_edge, drop_old], today)
+    assert result == [drop_old]
+
+
+def test_to_remove_explicit_retention():
+    today = date(2026, 11, 18)
+    a = _draft("a", today, 10)
+    b = _draft("b", today, 20)
+    assert drafts.to_remove([a, b], today, retention_days=14) == [b]
+
+
+def test_to_remove_empty():
+    assert drafts.to_remove([], date(2026, 11, 18)) == []
